power_equation_audit.projection: actual-coordinate trapezoidal NUDFT: sampled=sum(wx*wy*field*exp(-i*(2*pi*m*x/Px+2*pi*n*y/Py)))/(Px*Py); inclusive-coordinate trapezoid weights.
power_equation_audit.modal_basis: 6-component least-squares fit to four passive local-medium TE/TM forward/backward modes; kz=passive_sqrt((n*k0)^2-kx^2-ky^2); H=(n/ETA0)*(k_hat cross E_hat).
power_equation_audit.modal_power: P_mode=0.5*Re(cross(E_mode,conj(H_mode))_z)*abs(C_norm)^2; propagating order uses positive Re(power_z_per_abs_e2), backward uses absolute value for reflected power.
power_equation_audit.grating_truth: launcher uses in_plus=0.5*(E+Z0*H/n), in_minus=0.5*(E-Z0*H/n), post_plus analogously; R=Re(n_gan)*abs(in_minus)^2/(Re(n_gan)*abs(in_plus)^2), T=abs(post_plus)^2/(Re(n_gan)*abs(in_plus)^2); order source power=abs(total_power)*real(grating_fraction).
convention_audit: Fourier area normalization recorded and unchanged
phasor fields are complex monitor fields; no extra time-average factor is inserted into launcher R/T
modal metric contains the 0.5 time-average and ETA0/admittance through H
passive complex kz and forward/backward signs are explicit
TE/TM basis and polarization normalization are explicit
reference-plane de-embedding is applied before incident normalization
grating truth uses monitor-specific scalar normalization and is independently persisted

PRENP_PLUSZ_MODAL_ONLY.note: No independent PRENP grating-order source truth is saved; this is a derived modal-flux diagnostic only.

definitions.N1_INCIDENT_NORMALIZED: reapply deterministic incident flux/phase normalization; algebraically identical to N0 under current canonical state
definitions.N2_PROP_POWER_SEPARATED: C_hat=C/sqrt(sum_abs_C2 over target propagating direction); P_scale=saved HF R/T (PRENP uses derived modal diagnostic)
definitions.N3_POWER_METRIC_UNIT: C_hat=C/sqrt(sum(P_mode_abs*abs(C)^2) over target propagating direction); P_scale=saved HF R/T
definitions.N4_POWER_METRIC_PHASE_GAUGE: N3 plus incident-field physical unit-phase gauge; current frozen gauge makes it numerically equal to N3
